Volkswagen model sales totals

Updated 2026-07-31. Cumulative sales: Golf about 37 million units worldwide by end of 2024, the best-selling Volkswagen. Passat about 34 million units worldwide

Golf sales milestone

Updated 2026-03-02. Volkswagen reported that Golf production passed 35 million units in 2019; independent registries put cumulative sales at about 35.5 million by end of 2024.
